children: Pan Ocean could post a 3Q earnings beat on robust market conditions for bulk carriers and tankers, iM Securities' Bae Se-ho says. The analyst expects the South Korean shipping company's operating profit to have jumped 55% from a year earlier to 194 billion won for the July-September quarter, above the market consensus estimate of 184 billion won. Higher iron ore shipments from China and Brazil as well as rising tanker freight rates amid Middle East conflicts likely boosted Pan Ocean's 3Q earnings, Bae says. He is also positive about the company's expanding fleet of very large crude carriers, citing surging VLCC freight rates amid the conflicts. He raises his earnings-per-share estimate for Pan Ocean by 9% this year. (kwanwoo.jun@wsj.com)
